<section class="hr-section process-section">
<div class="hr-section-heading"><span class="section-number">05</span><div><p class="eyebrow">Working style</p><h2>A practical analytical loop.</h2></div></div>
<div class="process-grid"><div><strong>Frame</strong><p>Start with the decision, owner, time horizon, and definition of success.</p></div><div><strong>Diagnose</strong><p>Separate signal from noise with clean definitions, exploratory analysis, and segment-level views.</p></div><div><strong>Validate</strong><p>Stress-test assumptions with backtests, experiments, sensitivity checks, and uncertainty.</p></div><div><strong>Operationalize</strong><p>Package the result in a dashboard, recommendation table, or workflow that a team can reuse.</p></div></div>
</section>
